On Tuesday 3 November GitHub's Git Operations degraded for an hour and 44 minutes. On Wednesday morning they went again for two hours and a minute, this time taking Issues and Pull Requests along, and Actions followed with two separate incidents that afternoon. Every one of them closed with the same sentence, promising a detailed root cause analysis as soon as it is available. The last time this happened, in October, a Hacker News commenter was still getting Internal Server Error after the page had moved to All Systems Operational.
